name: smwgraphics-kirby-mass-attack-balloons
title: Kirby Mass Attack - Balloons
description:
These are the balloons that appear from Kirby Mass Attack DS. They act as Layer 3 background balloons that will rise vertically via Layer 3 auto scroll.

Rykon-V73 Edit: Palettes have better optimization and use less palette space along with some additional sized balloons added with strings on the balloon.

Needs a custom status bar like the Minimalist or DKCR one. Or even the Remove Status Bar patch .

Does not work well with the vanilla status bar.
